item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Crispy fried pork belly with new potatoes and parsley sauce. Served with pickles on the side. (1+6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Chicken souvlaki, Greek chicken skewers, with oregano and pepper roasted potatoes and pita bread. Served with tzatziki and a green Greek salad on the side. (1+6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu souvlaki, Greek skewers with tofu, with oregano and pepper roasted potatoes and pita bread. Served with tzatziki and a green Greek salad on the side. (1+6+7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Mexican mole, a deep bean sauce served with pulled pork and a fresh vegetable salsa with chilli and lime. Served with flatbread. (1+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Mexican mole, a deep bean sauce served with pulled, spiced tofu and a fresh vegetable salsa with chilli and lime. Served with flatbread. (1+7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Chicken gyros, Greek comfort food. Spiced chicken on Greek flatbread with a classic Greek salad. (1+6+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Halloumi gyros, Greek comfort food. Spiced halloumi on Greek flatbread with a classic Greek salad. (1+6+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Shrimp po'boy, a classic New Orleans sandwich, soft roll filled with fresh greens, corn-fried prawns and po'boy dressing, served with crispy fries. Served with creamy coleslaw, tangy onion and mushroom sauce, ketchup, remoulade and mayonnaise.
